candidate_windows.window_text: With the assistance of LLaMA Factory (Zheng et al., 2024),we used LoRA (Hu et al., 2022) and ORPO (Hong et al., 2024) to align our chosen instruction-tuned models. The cutoff length was set to 1,O24, the effective batch size was 16, the learning rate was 5.Oe-7, and we set the number of epochs to 3. We utilized the dpo_mix_en dataset (Zheng et al., 2O24) as the alignment training data. This dataset comprises 1O,OOO entries with high chosen scores from the distilabel versions (Bartolome et al., 2O23) of Capybara (Daniele and Suphavadeeprasit, 2023), Orca (Mukherjee et al., 2023),and UltraFeedback(Cui et al., 2023). We conducted our experiments using 4 NVIDIA RTX 3090, with the entire process taking approximately 100 hours.
